info.title: Roamify API
info.description: OpenAPI description of the Roamify partner API (eSIMs, insurance, exchange rates, affiliate links and webhooks), derived from the documentation at https://docs.getroamify.com. The documentation is the source of truth; where this file and the docs differ, follow the docs.

tags.name: eSIM Catalog
tags.description: Supported countries, eSIM packages and compatible devices.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Create and retrieve eSIM orders, including top-up and instant orders.

tags.name: eSIMs
tags.description: Generate eSIM profiles and manage eSIMs: usage, top-up packages, history, SMS, eSIMs Link and lifecycle events.

tags.name: Vouchers
tags.description: Redeemable voucher codes that each hand one eSIM to whoever redeems them. Selected partners only, enabled per API key.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Refund requests for eSIMs on your orders. A refund happens only after Roamify support approves the request.

tags.name: Insurance
tags.description: Travel insurance: countries, packages, orders and policies. Saudi Arabia citizens and residents only.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Event notifications Roamify sends to your webhook endpoint. Each request carries an `X-Roamify-Signature` header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with your secret key).

get.description: Health check endpoint that you can use to check the status of the Roamify API. You can send a `GET` request to the health check endpoint; the response will contain the status of the API.

200.description: The response contains the status of the API. The docs do not document the response body.

get.description: Returns the list of eSIM supported countries. Use the returned `name` and `code` when querying `/api/esim/packages`: `country` must use `name` and `countryCode` must use `code`. Arbitrary country strings are not accepted.

parameters.name: geography
parameters.description: Filter countries by geography scope.

get.description: Returns eSIM packages, paginated. If you do not pass `page` and `pageSize`, you may only receive the first page. To fetch all packages, iterate pages until the current page returns fewer items than your `pageSize`. `country` and `countryCode` have different meanings; both must use values returned from `GET /api/esim/countries`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Full country name filter. Use the `name` value from `GET /api/esim/countries`.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO country code filter. Use the `code` value from `GET /api/esim/countries`.

parameters.name: geography
parameters.description: The geography of the eSIM packages: `local`, `regional` or `global` packages.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The number of days for which the eSIM package is valid.

parameters.name: gbs
parameters.description: The amount of data in GB for which the eSIM package is valid.

parameters.name: isUnlimited
parameters.description: The flag to indicate if the eSIM package is unlimited.

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: The ID of the eSIM package.

200.description: A page of eSIM packages grouped by destination.

get.description: Returns the list of eSIM compatible devices. There are no required parameters for this endpoint.

data.model: Samsung Galaxy Note 20 / Note 20 Plus / Note 20 Ultra
data.name: Samsung Galaxy Note 20 series

post.description: Creates an eSIM order. The response contains a dedicated `esimId` for each eSIM; use it (or the order's `referenceId`) with `POST /api/esim/apply` to generate the eSIM profile.

packageId.description: The ID of the eSIM package you want to order.

quantity.description: The quantity of the eSIM package you want to order.

items.description: The eSIM items you want to order.

referenceId.description: Your custom reference ID for the order, if needed.

get.description: Returns a specific eSIM order. You are required to provide either `orderId` or `referenceId` as a query parameter.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The ID of the eSIM order you want to retrieve. Provide either `orderId` or `referenceId`.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: The reference ID of the eSIM order you want to retrieve. Provide either `orderId` or `referenceId`.

post.description: Creates a top-up order for an existing eSIM. Top-up works only for eSIMs that support top-up (`withTopUp = true`). Get compatible packages first with `GET /api/esim/topup/packages`.

iccid.description: The ICCID of the eSIM you want to top-up.

packageId.description: The ID of the eSIM package you want to top-up.

referenceId.description: Your custom reference ID for the top-up order, if needed.

post.description: Creates an eSIM order and returns the fulfilled eSIMs. There is no need to call `/api/esim/apply` with this endpoint. Set your request timeout to at least 60 seconds; depending on what you order, the fulfillment time can vary.

packageId.description: The ID of the eSIM package you want to order.

quantity.description: The quantity of the eSIM package you want to order.

items.description: The eSIM items you want to order.

referenceId.description: Your custom reference ID for the order, if needed.

200.description: The created order with its eSIMs.

get.description: Returns a list of eSIM orders. There are no required parameters for this endpoint.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the eSIM orders: `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, `ARCHIVED`, `CANCELLED`, `REFUNDED`, or `REQUIRE_ACTION` (orders that require action).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of eSIM orders to return.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: The reference ID of the eSIM orders you want to retrieve.

post.description: Generates an eSIM profile for an `esimId` from your order. If you created the order with a `referenceId`, you can use it to generate profiles for all eSIMs in the order; the response is then an array of eSIMs. Profile generation can take up to 90 seconds; set your request timeout to at least 90 seconds. If the request times out or fails with "eSIM is still pending processing", retrieve the eSIM with `GET /api/esim?esimId=...`.

referenceId.description: The reference ID of the eSIM order. If you do not provide a reference ID, the API generates a single eSIM profile for the provided `esimId`.

startDate.description: Travel start date in ISO 8601 format (for example `2026-07-01`). Required only when the package's `requirements.travelDate` is `true`.

200.description: The generated eSIM profile, or an array of eSIM profiles when `referenceId` was used.

get.description: Returns the usage of an eSIM. If the eSIM's `withUsageCheck` is `false`, usage check is not supported; find instructions in the `notes` property.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM.

get.description: Returns the usage of an eSIM with data usage records. If the eSIM's `withUsageCheck` is `false`, usage check is not supported; find instructions in the `notes` property.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM.

get.description: Returns the top-up packages compatible with an eSIM. Use a returned `packageId` with `POST /api/esim/order/topup`.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The number of days for which the eSIM package is valid.

parameters.name: gbs
parameters.description: The amount of data in GB for which the eSIM package is valid.

parameters.name: isUnlimited
parameters.description: The flag to indicate if the eSIM package is unlimited.

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: The ID of the eSIM package.

get.description: Returns the history of eSIM packages applied to an eSIM.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM.

get.summary: Get eSIM by ICCID or eSIM ID
get.description: Returns an eSIM. The endpoint requires either `iccid` or `esimId`, but not both. Use `esimId` to retrieve the eSIM when a generate eSIM profile request failed due to server load.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM. Provide either `iccid` or `esimId`, but not both.

parameters.name: esimId
parameters.description: The ID of the eSIM. Provide either `iccid` or `esimId`, but not both.

get.description: Returns a list of eSIMs. There are no required parameters for this endpoint.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: `NEW` (not yet processed), `READY` (ready to be downloaded), `INSTALLED`, `REVOKED`, `EXPIRED` or `UNKNOWN`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of eSIMs to return.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: Filter the eSIMs by reference ID.

post.description: Sends an SMS message to an eSIM. Both `iccid` and `message` are required in the request body.

200.description: Request accepted. The docs do not document the response body.

post.description: After you have created an eSIM profile, generates a link to share with your customers. The link allows them to install the eSIM profile on their devices, protected by an access code. Provide `iccid` or `esimId`; `esimId` is not needed if you included the `iccid`.

esimId.description: The ID of the eSIM. No need to provide it if you included the `iccid`.

get.description: Returns the end-to-end lifecycle events of an eSIM, when applicable, to help you and your support team understand its history. At least one of `iccid`, `esimId`, or `referenceId` is required.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: The ICCID of the eSIM. At least one of `iccid`, `esimId`, or `referenceId` is required.

parameters.name: esimId
parameters.description: The esimId provided by Roamify.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: The referenceId provided by you when creating the order.

200.description: The eSIM events. Note: the documented response is not wrapped in `status`/`data`.

get.description: Returns the remaining balance of your funds. There are no required parameters for this endpoint.

post.description: Mints a batch of redeemable voucher codes, each backed by a real eSIM bundle created up front. Always send a `referenceId`: creating vouchers is not idempotent on its own, and a repeat of a batch that already landed is rejected with `409`. `quantity` can come back lower than `requestedQuantity` if the batch stopped part-way; compare the two on every response and mint the shortfall as a new batch with a new `referenceId`. Selected partners only: voucher endpoints are enabled per API key; if the feature is not enabled on your key, every voucher endpoint returns `403`.

packageId.description: The ID of the eSIM package to mint vouchers for. It must be one of the packages your API key is allowed to mint.

quantity.description: How many vouchers to mint. A whole number between 1 and 10.

referenceId.description: Your own identifier for this batch. It must not have been used for a previous batch.

notes.description: A free-text note stored on every voucher in the batch. May be an empty string.

referenceId.description: The reference ID you sent, or an empty string if you did not send one.

requestedQuantity.description: How many vouchers you asked for.

quantity.description: How many vouchers were actually created.

400.description: Validation error. Documented messages: ""packageId" is required" | ""quantity" must be a number" | ""quantity" must be greater than or equal to 1" | ""quantity" must be less than or equal to 10" | "Invalid quantity, please provide a whole number of at least 1"

401.description: "Unauthorized, please make sure your have provided the correct api key"

403.description: Voucher feature not enabled, or package not allowed. Documented messages: "Voucher creation is not enabled for this API key, please contact support to have it enabled" | "This packageId is not allowed for voucher creation with this API key, please use one of the packages allowed for your account"

409.description: "Vouchers with the same referenceId already exist, please make sure you have provided a unique referenceId"

500.description: "Failed to create vouchers, please try again later"

503.description: "Vouchers cannot be issued at the moment, please retry shortly or contact support"

get.description: Returns your vouchers, newest first (sorted by `createdAt` descending). `limit` is applied after sorting; omitting `limit` returns every matching voucher. This endpoint is not paginated; if you mint large volumes, filter by `referenceId` per batch. Selected partners only: voucher endpoints are enabled per API key; if the feature is not enabled on your key, every voucher endpoint returns `403`.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: Return only the vouchers minted under this reference ID.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only the vouchers in this status, in uppercase.

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: Return only the vouchers for this package.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of vouchers to return. A whole number of at least 1.

referenceId.description: Echoes back the `referenceId` you filtered on, or an empty string if you did not filter by one.

400.description: Validation error. Documented messages: ""status" must be one of [ACTIVE, REDEEMED, CANCELLED]" | ""limit" must be greater than or equal to 1"

401.description: "Unauthorized, please make sure your have provided the correct api key"

403.description: "Voucher creation is not enabled for this API key, please contact support to have it enabled"

500.description: "Failed to get vouchers, please try again later"

get.description: Returns a single voucher by its ID. Selected partners only: voucher endpoints are enabled per API key; if the feature is not enabled on your key, every voucher endpoint returns `403`.

parameters.name: voucherId
parameters.description: The ID of the voucher, as returned in the voucher's `id` field.

401.description: "Unauthorized, please make sure your have provided the correct api key"

403.description: "Voucher creation is not enabled for this API key, please contact support to have it enabled"

404.description: "Voucher not found, please make sure you have provided the correct voucher ID or code". A voucher belonging to another partner is reported as `404`, not `403`.

500.description: "Failed to get vouchers, please try again later"

get.description: Looks a voucher up by the code you handed out. The code is normalised before it is matched: trimmed, upper-cased, and every character that is not a letter or digit is stripped, so `r7k2-m9qx-4b1d` and `R7K2M9QX4B1D` resolve to the same voucher. After normalisation the code must be exactly 12 alphanumeric characters; anything else is reported as `404`. Selected partners only: voucher endpoints are enabled per API key; if the feature is not enabled on your key, every voucher endpoint returns `403`.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The voucher code.

401.description: "Unauthorized, please make sure your have provided the correct api key"

403.description: "Voucher creation is not enabled for this API key, please contact support to have it enabled"

404.description: "Voucher not found, please make sure you have provided the correct voucher ID or code". A voucher belonging to another partner is reported as `404`, not `403`.

500.description: "Failed to get vouchers, please try again later"

put.description: Cancels a voucher and the eSIM behind it. Use it for a code that was distributed by mistake, leaked, or is no longer wanted. Revoking is permanent. Only `ACTIVE` vouchers can be revoked. No request body is required. Selected partners only: voucher endpoints are enabled per API key; if the feature is not enabled on your key, every voucher endpoint returns `403`.

parameters.name: voucherId
parameters.description: The ID of the voucher to revoke.

401.description: "Unauthorized, please make sure your have provided the correct api key"

403.description: "Voucher creation is not enabled for this API key, please contact support to have it enabled"

404.description: "Voucher not found, please make sure you have provided the correct voucher ID or code". A voucher belonging to another partner is reported as `404`, not `403`.

409.description: The voucher cannot be revoked. Documented messages: "Voucher has already been redeemed and can no longer be revoked" | "Only active vouchers can be revoked, this voucher is no longer active"

500.description: "Failed to revoke voucher, please try again later"

post.description: Asks Roamify support to refund one eSIM of one of your orders. Support reviews the request and the refund happens only after it is approved; submitting a request never moves money by itself and does not revoke the eSIM. An eSIM can have one open request at a time.

example.notes: The customer could not scan the QR code on an iPhone 12.

201.description: The new refund request, with a `tracking` object that tells you where to poll it.

example.notes: The customer could not scan the QR code on an iPhone 12.

400.description: `INVALID_PARAMETER`: a parameter is missing or invalid (for example both or neither of `iccid` and `esimId`). `REFUND_INVALID_REASON`: `reason` is not a supported reason. `REFUND_NOTES_REQUIRED`: `reason` is `OTHER` without `notes` of at least 10 characters.

401.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

403.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

404.description: `ESIM_NOT_FOUND`: no eSIM of your account has that `iccid` or `esimId`.

409.description: `REFUND_REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS`: the eSIM already has an open (`PENDING` or `PROCESSING`) request. The body carries its `refundId`.

422.description: `REFUND_NOT_ELIGIBLE`: the eSIM cannot be refunded; `reasons` lists why, for example `ESIM_ALREADY_REFUNDED`. `REFUND_PRODUCT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`: only `esim` is supported.

429.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

500.description: `REFUND_CREATE_FAILED`, `REFUND_GET_FAILED`, `REFUND_CANCEL_FAILED` or `REFUND_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: a temporary failure. Try again later.

get.description: Returns one refund request. Send exactly one of `refundId`, `esimId` or `iccid`.

parameters.name: refundId
parameters.description: The request. Send exactly one of `refundId`, `esimId` or `iccid`.

parameters.name: esimId
parameters.description: Returns the newest request for that eSIM.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: Returns the newest request for that ICCID.

400.description: `INVALID_PARAMETER`: a parameter is missing or invalid.

401.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

429.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

500.description: `REFUND_CREATE_FAILED`, `REFUND_GET_FAILED`, `REFUND_CANCEL_FAILED` or `REFUND_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: a temporary failure. Try again later.

post.description: Requests refunds for several eSIMs in one call. A bad entry fails the whole call with `400`, and nothing is created. Entries that are valid but refused individually (for example an eSIM that already has an open request) are reported in the results instead, one result per entry in the order you sent them.

productType.description: What is refunded. Only `esim` is supported for now. It applies to every entry.

200.description: One result per entry, in the order you sent them.

error.message: A refund request is already open for this eSIM

400.description: A bad entry fails the whole call and nothing is created. `INVALID_PARAMETER` (for example more than 20 entries), `REFUND_INVALID_REASON` or `REFUND_NOTES_REQUIRED`.

401.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

403.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

429.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

500.description: `REFUND_CREATE_FAILED`, `REFUND_GET_FAILED`, `REFUND_CANCEL_FAILED` or `REFUND_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: a temporary failure. Try again later.

get.description: Lists your refund requests, newest first. All query parameters are optional. When `nextCursor` is not `null`, send it back as `cursor` to get the next page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only requests with this status.

parameters.name: iccid
parameters.description: Only requests for that eSIM. Send at most one of `iccid` or `esimId`.

parameters.name: esimId
parameters.description: Only requests for that eSIM. Send at most one of `iccid` or `esimId`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page.

nextCursor.description: Send it back as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

401.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

403.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

429.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

500.description: `REFUND_CREATE_FAILED`, `REFUND_GET_FAILED`, `REFUND_CANCEL_FAILED` or `REFUND_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: a temporary failure. Try again later.

put.description: Withdraws a refund request. Only a request that is still `PENDING` can be cancelled. You can submit a new request for the same eSIM afterwards.

parameters.name: refundId
parameters.description: The ID of the refund request.

401.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

403.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

409.description: `REFUND_INVALID_STATUS`: only a `PENDING` request can be cancelled.

429.description: Authentication error. Carries a `code` as well.

500.description: `REFUND_CREATE_FAILED`, `REFUND_GET_FAILED`, `REFUND_CANCEL_FAILED` or `REFUND_SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: a temporary failure. Try again later.

get.description: Returns the countries covered by the insurance catalog. Only countries that have at least one activated insurance product are returned, deduplicated by `code` and sorted alphabetically by `name`. Use `name` as `country` and `code` as `countryCode` on `/api/insurance/packages`. Eligibility: insurance packages may only be sold to travellers who are citizens or residents of Saudi Arabia.

parameters.name: geography
parameters.description: Filter countries by geography scope. Matching is case-insensitive.

get.description: Returns insurance products with their packages. Not paginated; do not send `page` or `pageSize`. Only activated products and packages are returned; a product whose packages are all filtered out is omitted. A `country` or `countryCode` value that does not match exactly yields an empty `packages` array, not an error. Eligibility: insurance packages may only be sold to travellers who are citizens or residents of Saudi Arabia.

parameters.name: geography
parameters.description: The geography of the insurance packages. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Full country name filter. Use the `name` value from `GET /api/insurance/countries`.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO country code filter. Use the `code` value from `GET /api/insurance/countries`.

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: The ID of a specific insurance package.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: The coverage duration in days. Only packages whose `day` matches exactly are returned.

packages.name: Saudi Arabia Travel Insurance
packages.description: Travel insurance for Saudi Arabia citizens and residents.
benefits: Emergency medical cover up to USD 50,000

get.description: Returns the full product the package belongs to, with its `packages` array narrowed to the single package you requested. Eligibility: insurance packages may only be sold to travellers who are citizens or residents of Saudi Arabia.

parameters.name: packageId
parameters.description: The ID of the insurance package you want to retrieve.

data.name: Saudi Arabia Travel Insurance
data.description: Travel insurance for Saudi Arabia citizens and residents.
benefits: Emergency medical cover up to USD 50,000

404.description: "Insurance package not found, please make sure you have provided a valid packageId"

500.description: "Failed to get insurance packages, please try again later"

post.description: Reserves one policy per unit of quantity and debits your partner balance. It does not issue anything: issue each reserved policy (`policyId`) against a named traveller with `POST /api/insurance/apply`. Every `packageId` must start with `insurance-`. The total quantity across all items in a single order cannot exceed 5. `referenceId` must be unique across your orders; reusing one returns `409`. Eligibility: insurance packages may only be sold to travellers who are citizens or residents of Saudi Arabia.

packageId.description: The ID of the insurance package you want to order. Must start with `insurance-`.

quantity.description: The number of policies to reserve for this package.

items.description: The insurance items you want to order. At least one item is required. Total quantity across all items cannot exceed 5.

referenceId.description: Your custom reference ID for the order, if needed. Must be unique across your orders.

400.description: Validation error. Documented messages: "Only insurance packages can be ordered through this endpoint. Every packageId must start with 'insurance-'; use POST /esim/order for eSIM packages" | "Invalid quantity, please make sure your have provided the correct quantity" | "Exceed maximum total quantity of 5, please make sure your have provided the correct quantity and the quantity does not exceed the maximum allowed quantity 5" | "Missing required fields, please provide all required fields according to the documentation"

409.description: Conflict. Documented messages: "Order with the same referenceId already exists, please make sure your have provided a unique referenceId" | "Insufficient partner balance, please recharge it first before placing order"

get.description: Returns a specific insurance order. You must provide exactly one of `orderId` or `referenceId`; providing both, or neither, is a validation error. This endpoint only resolves insurance orders; an eSIM order ID returns `404`.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The ID of the insurance order. Provide exactly one of `orderId` or `referenceId`.

parameters.name: referenceId
parameters.description: The reference ID of the insurance order. Provide exactly one of `orderId` or `referenceId`.

404.description: "Order not found, please make sure your have provided the correct orderId or referenceId"

get.description: Returns insurance orders, newest first (sorted by `createdAt` descending). Only orders you placed through the API are included.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the insurance orders to return. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of insurance orders to return.

post.description: Issues a reserved policy against a named traveller. `dateOfBirth`, `idNumber`, `passportNumber` and (via `phoneNumber`) `mobile` are governed by the package's `requirements` object, snapshotted onto the policy; `mobile` and `email` are required on every call. Validation is deliberately looser than the provider's, so passing it does not guarantee issuance. Applying to a policy that is already `ISSUED`, `ACTIVE`, or `EXPIRED` returns `409`; issuance is not idempotent, so do not blindly retry on `409`; if the policy is being issued, poll `GET /api/insurance/policy`. Eligibility: insurance packages may only be sold to travellers who are citizens or residents of Saudi Arabia.

benefits: Emergency medical cover up to USD 50,000

400.description: Validation error. Documented messages: "This insurance package requires idNumber, please provide insurer.idNumber" | "This insurance package requires passportNumber, please provide insurer.passportNumber" | "This insurance package requires dateOfBirth, please provide insurer.dateOfBirth in the format DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 24/06/1990)" | "This insurance package requires phoneNumber, please provide mobile in international format without the leading '+' (e.g. 966512345678)" | "Invalid traveller name, please provide both insurer.firstName and insurer.lastName" | "Invalid nationality, please provide insurer.nationality" | "Invalid idNumber, please provide a valid identification number for the traveller" | "Invalid passportNumber, please provide a valid passport number for the traveller" | "Invalid dateOfBirth, please provide a past date in the format DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 24/06/1990)" | "Invalid mobile, please provide 8 to 15 digits in international format without the leading '+' (e.g. 966512345678)" | "Invalid email, please provide a valid email address for the traveller" | "Invalid startDate, please provide the coverage start date in the format DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01/08/2026)" | "Invalid endDate, please provide the coverage end date in the format DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 08/08/2026) and make sure it is after startDate" | "Coverage cannot start today, please provide a startDate at least 1 day in the future" | "The requested coverage window is longer than the purchased package allows, please shorten it or buy a longer package" | "Insurance details failed validation, please make sure you have provided all the required traveller fields"

404.description: "Insurance policy not found, please make sure you have provided the correct policyId"

409.description: The policy cannot be applied. Documented messages: "This insurance policy has already been issued and cannot be applied again" | "This insurance policy is currently being issued, please retry with GET /insurance/policy?policyId=id after some time" | "A policy has already been issued for this reference, please contact support if you believe this is an error"

502.description: Provider failure. Documented messages: "Failed to issue the insurance policy, please try again later or contact support" | "The insurance provider rejected the request, please verify the traveller details and try again"

get.description: Returns a specific insurance policy. Use it to read the `requirements` for a policy you already hold, and to poll for the issued policy document after a `409` telling you issuance is in progress. A policy belonging to another partner is reported as `404`, not `403`.

parameters.name: policyId
parameters.description: The ID of the insurance policy you want to retrieve.

benefits: Emergency medical cover up to USD 50,000

404.description: "Insurance policy not found, please make sure you have provided the correct policyId"

get.description: Returns all supported currencies. The request does not require any parameters.

200.description: Supported currencies. The docs do not document the response body.

get.description: Returns exchange rates between a source and a target currency. Without `datetime`, `from`, `to` or `interval`, the latest exchange rate is used. Pass `datetime` to convert at a point in time, or `from`/`to` with `interval` for historical data. If `datetime` is provided, do not provide `from`, `to` or `interval`; if `from` or `to` is provided, also provide `interval` and do not provide `datetime`. Otherwise the API returns an error.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source currency code.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The target currency code.

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: The date and time for which you want the exchange rate, in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, the latest exchange rate is used. Do not combine with `from`, `to` or `interval`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The start date for the historical data, in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The end date for the historical data, in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: The interval for the historical data. Required when `from` or `to` is provided.

200.description: Exchange rate data. The docs do not document the response body.

The referral link includes your unique identifier, which is used to track the sales you make. Customers must click your referral link for the sale to be tracked.

parameters.name: partnerSlug
parameters.description: Your dedicated unique name, assigned when you are onboarded.

200.description: eSIM packages per country, each with your referral link.

post.description: Sent when an eSIM's status changes (activation, deactivation, suspension or other state changes). Roamify sends an HTTPS `POST` to the webhook URL configured in the Roamify dashboard. Verify the `X-Roamify-Signature` header before processing.

parameters.name: X-Roamify-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body computed with your webhook secret key, hex-encoded. Recompute it and compare in constant time; reject the request if it does not match.

200.description: Acknowledge receipt with 200 OK quickly (within 3 seconds), then process the event in the background. If your endpoint does not respond in time, Roamify retries the webhook up to 3 times at increasing intervals.

bearerAuth.description: Send your Access Token (called API Key in the Roamify Partner Portal) in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer <token>`. The token is long-lived and stays valid until you rotate it in the Partner Portal under API Keys; after rotation the old token is invalidated immediately.

Voucher.description: Every voucher endpoint returns the same voucher shape. Statuses: `ACTIVE` (minted, not yet claimed; can be redeemed and revoked), `REDEEMED` (claimed by a customer; can no longer be revoked), `CANCELLED` (revoked; the code and the eSIM behind it are dead).

RefundReason.description: Why you are asking for the refund. `UNABLE_TO_INSTALL`: the eSIM could not be installed or activated on the device. `NO_CONNECTIVITY`: installed but no data connection at the destination. `WRONG_PACKAGE`: the wrong destination or data plan was purchased. `DUPLICATE_PURCHASE`: purchased more than once by mistake. `TRIP_CANCELLED`: the trip was cancelled or changed. `DEVICE_NOT_COMPATIBLE`: the device does not support eSIM or is locked. `CUSTOMER_REQUEST`: the customer changed their mind. `OTHER`: anything else; `notes` of at least 10 characters are required.

RefundStatus.description: `PENDING`: submitted, not yet acted on; can be cancelled. `PROCESSING`: approved, refund being processed. `REFUNDED`: refund complete and the eSIM was deactivated. `REJECTED`: support rejected the request (see `rejectionReason`, `rejectionNote`). `CANCELLED`: you cancelled the request before review.

iccid.description: Only once the eSIM was redeemed.

RefundRequest.description: A request asking Roamify support to refund one eSIM of one of your orders. The refund happens only after support approves it.

refundId.description: For `REFUND_REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS`: the `refundId` of the open request.

reasons.description: For `REFUND_NOT_ELIGIBLE`: why the eSIM cannot be refunded, for example `ESIM_ALREADY_REFUNDED`.

RefundError.description: Every refund error has the form `{ "message": "...", "status": "failed", "code": "..." }`.

productType.description: What is refunded. Only `esim` is supported for now. Any other value is answered with `422` `REFUND_PRODUCT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`.

iccid.description: Use `iccid` for an eSIM that was redeemed. Provide exactly one of `iccid` or `esimId`.

esimId.description: Use `esimId` for an eSIM that has no ICCID yet, such as a bundle that was never assigned. Provide exactly one of `iccid` or `esimId`.

notes.description: Free text for the support team, up to 1000 characters. Required, with at least 10 characters, when `reason` is `OTHER`.
Free text for the support team, up to 1000 characters. Required, with at least 10 characters, when `reason` is `OTHER`.

index.description: Position of the entry in the request.

status.description: `CREATED`: the request was created and `refund` holds it. `FAILED`: the request was refused and `error` holds the `code` and `message`, plus `reasons` (for `REFUND_NOT_ELIGIBLE`) or the open `refundId` (for `REFUND_REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS`). `DUPLICATE`: the same `iccid` or `esimId` appeared earlier in the call; only the first is created.

duplicateOf.description: For `DUPLICATE`: the index of the entry that was kept.
